name: Shanghai Phoenix Enterprise (Group) Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Phoenix Enterprise (Group) Co., Ltd. produces and sells bicycles in China. The company offers electric bicycles, two-wheeled motorcycles, children's bicycles, fitness equipment, bicycle industrial equipment, and molds; and operation and management of supporting products, properties, warehousing, and logistics. It also engages in the hotel industry; wholesale and retail; manufacturing; wholesale and retail; food and beverage; and investment management activities. The company was formerly known as Jinshan Development & Construction Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Shanghai Phoenix Enterprise (Group) Co., Ltd. in January 2016.
